fusions.name: Practiced Word
fusions.desc: A spoken strike that deals 16 damage, draws out every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Corrected Syllable
fusions.desc: Sends a seal of arcane light into the first enemy it meets, dealing 30 damage and leaving it [Spell Impetus] for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Inscribed Polyps
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds. A line of polyps fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rote Learning

riders.text: and the words come back sooner
and the growth feeds the body

fusions.desc: Raises your Spirit by 1, and your Spirit ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your mana recovers 12% faster, from silver your abilities come round 4% sooner, and from gold your health recovers 10% faster.
